const show = () => console.log(RegExp.$1, RegExp.$2, RegExp.lastMatch, RegExp.lastParen, RegExp.input, RegExp.leftContext, RegExp.rightContext);
/(?:)/.test("");
show();
/(a)(b)?/.test("xabz");
show();
/q/.test("nothing");
show();
"c3d4".match(/(\d)/g);
show();
"p5q".search(/(\d)/);
show();
"x6y7".replace(/(\d)/g, "!");
show();
for (const match of "x8y9".matchAll(/(\d)/g)) console.log(match[0], RegExp.$1);
show();
"a1b2".split(/(\d)/);
show();
RegExp.input = "override";
